sahneler.metin: Seconds after take-off from Bagram, a Boeing 747 pitched up steeply.
It stalled and crashed, killing all seven crew.
It was carrying heavy armoured vehicles.
Their straps had not been secured correctly.
As the jet climbed, a vehicle broke loose and rolled backward.
It damaged hydraulics and the tail's control system.
The pilots could not lower the nose.
Cargo restraint procedures were overhauled afterward.

aciklama:
National 102 stalled and crashed just after take-off. The cause: shifting cargo damaging hydraulics and the horizontal stabilizer drive, causing an unrecoverable pitch-up.
